title: Post-production crammed into two weeks
detect_signals: Post-production is planned in two weeks
Perrick's load goes over 100% in those weeks
sim_effect: The plan assumes more hours than Perrick has; post slips and everything after it moves.
accepted_fixes: Give post-production its three weeks back
Spread post over three weeks and start the master site build in parallel
partial_fixes: Ask Perrick for overtime in those weeks
sop_ref: Media SOP 4M: rough cut and final cut rounds
explanation: A plan that needs more hours than a person has will slip, and overtime adds mistakes. Planning below full load leaves room for the review rounds post always needs.
note: On Rescue, post already has two weeks of overtime (11-12), so the plant moves post to weeks 12-13 where only one week has overtime. Planted on the three original projects; the plants name tasks the newer projects do not have.
